title: Chat timeline
summary: Shows the messages of one chat, loads older ones on scroll, and sends text.

id.description: The SDK's unique timeline item id. Stable key for the row.

kind.description: text: a text message. undecryptable: the phone has no key for it yet. unsupported: any other event type in the slice.

body.description: Plain text of a text message.

isOwn.description: true when this account sent it.

sentAt.description: Origin server time of the event.

sendState.description: Only own messages use sending and failed.

roomName.description: The chat name for the title.

messages.description: Oldest first, as the timeline listener gives the items.

reachedStart.description: true when the start of the chat is loaded.

peerAway.description: DM only (RoomInfo.isDm, ADR 0141). left: Room.member of the other person has membership leave (or ban). accountGone: also Client.getProfile for the person fails with ErrorKind notFound (a deactivated account has no profile). none: joined or invited, or a group.

loadHistory.effect: Back-paginates 20 events when the view scrolls near the top. Does nothing when reachedStart is true or a load runs.

send.effect: Sends draft as a plain-text message through the timeline, then clears draft. The message shows at once with sendState sending.

retrySend.effect: Sends a failed own message again.

inviteAgain.effect: peerAway left only. When RoomPowerLevels.canOwnUserInvite: Room.inviteUserById for the other person; peerAway turns none once the person is invited, so the bar goes away. Else (a DM created with the DM power levels, where nobody can invite): a new DM with the person, as person-profile message does, and chat-timeline opens it. The new room is the newest, so dm-selection shows it and hides this one; nothing is deleted. A failure shows bipe_dm_invite_again_failed.

notes: Send is off while draft is blank after trimming.
undecryptable shows the message-undecryptable row in place of the body (cause and help action there).

timeline-rows replaces messages with rows. Replies, reactions, edits, deletions, read receipts, typing, the actions sheet, handle-change lines and scam warnings have their own specs (bipe-chat/bipe#559). Media is a later issue.

The other person left a DM (ADR 0141, bipe-chat/bipe#533): a lasting bar above the composer shows bipe_dm_left with the person's name and one button, bipe_action_invite_again. accountGone shows bipe_dm_account_gone with no button. There is no popup on composer focus. The composer stays on: a message waits in the room for a person who comes back.

A blocked person's DM (ADR 0141, bipe-chat/bipe#536, block-person): bipe_app_blocked_bar with the person's name and bipe_action_unblock_person replaces the composer. The chat stays in the list. The bar wins over the peerAway bar.
